scope: Corrected offline32mesh cooked collision model; same bounded2-start endpoint search as42, unchanged controls/criteria/limits. Not a runtime or self-mask model replacement. Bounded2-start local endpoint searches. Fixed actual1s feet and fixed-.35rad shoulder/elbow offsets, rootx[-.28,-.10],pitch5–38deg. The38deg research screen reserves2deg under the UNCHANGED40deg physical support criterion. Existing3mm model clearance/5mm footCoP/15mm pelvis patch screens. Hypothetical seat support is vertical static allocation, not measured legal loading. No step, path, rate, dynamics or support-transition certificate. Limited failures do not prove impossibility.
